stem.text: An air bubble is rising through a liquid at a constant speed. The forces on it are the upthrust $U$, the viscous drag $V$ and its weight $W$.
Which diagram shows the directions and relative sizes of the forces?

A.alt: Diagram of a small circle with an upward arrow labelled U above it and two downward arrows labelled W and V below it.

B.alt: Diagram of a small circle with an upward arrow labelled U above it, a downward arrow labelled W beside it, and a downward arrow labelled V below it.

C.alt: Diagram of a small circle with an upward arrow labelled U above it and two downward arrows labelled V and W below it.

D.alt: Diagram of a small circle with two upward arrows labelled V and U above it and a downward arrow labelled W below it.
